name: FINAL FANTASY VII Original Soundtrack
short_description: Still going strong more than 20 years on! This FINAL FANTASY VII album includes all the music Nobuo Uematsu composed for the classic game released in 1997. Especially noteworthy tracks include "Those Who Fight" and "One-Winged Angel."
about_the_game:
Still going strong more than 20 years on!
